qs.q: Which three pillars uphold every implementation of empirical process control in Scrum?
qs.e: Guía de Scrum 2020: el empirismo se apoya en transparencia, inspección y adaptación. Truco: no confundir con los valores ni con roles/eventos/artefactos.

qs.q: According to the Scrum Guide, Scrum is best described as:
o: A set of engineering techniques for software testing
A lightweight framework that helps people, teams and organizations generate value through adaptive solutions for complex problems
A detailed methodology that prescribes every practice a team must follow
A project management process with sequential phases
qs.e: La Guía 2020 define Scrum como un marco ligero para problemas complejos adaptativos. No es una metodología detallada ni fases secuenciales.

qs.q: Why is transparency required for inspection in Scrum?
o: Because it allows management to assign tasks
Because it replaces the need for adaptation
Without transparency, inspection can be misleading and wasteful
Because stakeholders must approve every artifact
qs.e: Guía 2020: la inspección sin transparencia es engañosa y un desperdicio. Los artefactos deben ser visibles para quienes los inspeccionan.

qs.q: On which two foundations is Scrum built?
o: Predictive planning and command and control
qs.e: La Guía 2020 dice que Scrum se basa en el empirismo y el pensamiento Lean. Truco: nada de planificación predictiva.

qs.q: What does lean thinking do in Scrum?
o: Reduces waste and focuses on the essentials
Adds more roles to improve control
Extends the Sprint to gain more time
qs.e: Guía 2020: el pensamiento Lean reduce el desperdicio y se centra en lo esencial.

qs.q: Which of the following is NOT one of the Scrum Values?
qs.e: Los valores son compromiso, enfoque, apertura, respeto y coraje. 'Efficiency' no es un valor de Scrum.

qs.q: What does empiricism assert in Scrum?
o: Knowledge comes from detailed upfront plans
Experience is less important than documentation
Knowledge comes from experience and making decisions based on what is observed
Decisions must be approved by management
qs.e: Guía 2020: el empirismo sostiene que el conocimiento viene de la experiencia y de decidir según lo observado.

qs.q: What is the typical size of a Scrum Team according to the Scrum Guide?
qs.e: Guía 2020: el Scrum Team es pequeño, típicamente de 10 personas o menos. Equipos pequeños se comunican mejor y son más productivos.

qs.q: Which statement about the Scrum framework is true?
o: Scrum is purposefully incomplete and only defines the parts required to implement Scrum theory
Scrum requires the use of a specific estimation technique
Scrum defines detailed instructions for every situation
Scrum prescribes the engineering practices to use
qs.e: Guía 2020: Scrum es deliberadamente incompleto; define solo las partes necesarias y deja el resto a las personas.

qs.q: What does adaptation mean in Scrum?
o: Changing the Definition of Done at the end of the project
Adjusting a process or what is being made as soon as possible when inspection shows deviations outside acceptable limits
Waiting for the next release to correct problems
Updating documentation after the Sprint ends
qs.e: Guía 2020: si la inspección detecta desviaciones fuera de límites aceptables, se ajusta lo antes posible para minimizar más desviaciones.

qs.q: The value of openness is demonstrated when:
o: All meetings are open to any employee
Team members share their personal data
The Scrum Team and its stakeholders are open about the work and the challenges
Everyone is open to working overtime
qs.e: Guía 2020: apertura significa ser abiertos con el trabajo y los desafíos. Truco: no es abrir las reuniones a todo el mundo.

qs.q: For what kind of problems is Scrum intended?
o: Problems whose solution is fully known upfront
qs.e: Guía 2020: Scrum ayuda a generar valor mediante soluciones adaptativas para problemas complejos.

qs.q: A manager asks if a team can use Scrum with its own additional techniques. According to the Scrum Guide:
o: Scrum is a framework within which people can employ various processes and techniques
Any addition makes it no longer Scrum, so none can be used
Additional techniques require Scrum Master approval
Only techniques listed in the Scrum Guide are allowed
qs.e: Guía 2020: Scrum es un marco en el que se pueden emplear otros procesos y técnicas, siempre que respeten las reglas de Scrum.

qs.q: A team uses only some parts of Scrum and drops the Retrospective. What does the Scrum Guide say?
o: It is acceptable if the Scrum Master agrees
Scrum exists only in its entirety; omitting elements causes problems and reduces the benefits
It is acceptable if the Sprint is shorter than two weeks
It is still Scrum, because it is customizable
qs.e: Guía 2020: Scrum solo existe en su totalidad; omitir elementos oculta problemas y limita beneficios. Trampa: 'Scrum-but'.

qs.q: What does cross-functional mean for a Scrum Team?
o: Every member can do every task equally well
Team includes a separate tester group
Members collectively have all the skills needed to create value each Sprint
Members come from different departments and keep their managers
qs.e: Guía 2020: multifuncional significa que los miembros tienen en conjunto todas las habilidades necesarias; no que todos sepan hacerlo todo.

qs.q: What does self-managing mean for a Scrum Team?
o: The Product Owner assigns work to each Developer
Management decides how the Sprint Backlog is worked
The Scrum Master assigns tasks to the Developers
The team decides internally who does what, when and how
qs.e: Guía 2020: el equipo es autogestionado; decide internamente quién hace qué, cuándo y cómo. El SM no asigna tareas.

qs.q: The Scrum Value of courage means:
o: Scrum Team members have the courage to do the right thing and work on tough problems
Taking on more work than the Developers can handle
qs.e: Guía 2020: coraje es hacer lo correcto y abordar problemas difíciles.

qs.q: The Scrum Value of focus means:
o: Only the Product Owner decides priorities
Everyone focuses on the work of the Sprint and the goals of the Scrum Team
Developers work on one task each until the end
qs.e: Guía 2020: enfoque es concentrarse en el trabajo del Sprint y en los objetivos del Scrum Team.

qs.q: What are Scrum events for?
o: They allow management to track individual performance
They are optional and can be skipped when busy
They are formal opportunities to inspect and adapt Scrum artifacts, creating regularity and minimizing the need for other meetings
They are status meetings for management
qs.e: Guía 2020: cada evento es una oportunidad formal de inspección y adaptación, y crea regularidad.

qs.q: What is the main change in the 2020 Scrum Guide regarding the team structure?
o: The team must now include a tester sub-team
A fourth role, the Scrum Coach, was added
The Scrum Master became the team manager
The Development Team was replaced by Developers inside a single Scrum Team with no sub-teams or hierarchies
qs.e: Guía 2020: un único Scrum Team (Developers, PO, SM) sin subequipos ni jerarquías.

qs.q: A team inspects its Increment every day but never changes anything based on what it sees. What does the Scrum Guide imply?
o: Inspection without adaptation is considered pointless
The team needs more transparency only
The team is applying Scrum correctly
The team should inspect less frequently
qs.e: Guía 2020: la inspección sin adaptación se considera inútil. Los eventos están diseñados para provocar cambio.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the Scrum Team accountability for 'creating value'?
o: Only the Product Owner interacts with stakeholders
The Scrum Team is responsible for all product-related activities, including collaboration with stakeholders, verification, maintenance and experimentation
Only the Developers are responsible for product delivery
The organization's managers are responsible for stakeholder collaboration
qs.e: Guía 2020: el Scrum Team es responsable de todas las actividades relacionadas con el producto, desde colaboración con interesados hasta mantenimiento.

qs.q: Which statement about respect as a Scrum Value is correct?
o: Respect means following instructions from management
Team members must always agree with the Product Owner
Scrum Team members respect each other to be capable, independent people
qs.e: Guía 2020: respeto es considerar a los demás personas capaces e independientes.

qs.q: Which TWO are foundations on which Scrum is founded? Choose TWO answers.
qs.e: Guía 2020: Scrum se funda en empirismo y pensamiento Lean.

qs.q: Which TWO are Scrum Values? Choose TWO answers.
qs.e: Valores 2020: compromiso, enfoque, apertura, respeto y coraje. Disciplina y previsibilidad no figuran.

qs.q: Which TWO are pillars of empirical process control? Choose TWO answers.
qs.e: Los tres pilares son transparencia, inspección y adaptación.

qs.q: Which TWO statements describe the Scrum Team? Choose TWO answers.
o: It is divided into a development and a testing sub-team
It is led by a project manager
qs.e: Guía 2020: equipo multifuncional y autogestionado, sin subequipos ni jerarquías.

qs.q: The Scrum Guide 2020 requires a Sprint burn-down chart for every Scrum Team.
qs.e: La Guía no exige burn-down; menciona herramientas como práctica útil pero no obligatoria.

qs.q: Scrum is based on empiricism: decisions are made on what is observed and experienced.
qs.e: Guía 2020: el empirismo es una de las dos bases de Scrum.

qs.q: Scrum Teams must plan the whole product upfront in detail before the first Sprint.
qs.e: Scrum es empírico y adaptativo; el Product Backlog evoluciona, no se fija por completo al inicio.

qs.q: Who is accountable for maximizing the value of the product resulting from the work of the Scrum Team?
qs.e: Guía 2020: el PO es responsable de maximizar el valor del producto.

qs.q: How many Product Owners can a Scrum Team have?
o: As many as there are stakeholder groups
qs.e: Guía 2020: el PO es una persona, no un comité. Puede representar deseos de muchos, pero decide uno.

qs.q: Who is accountable for establishing Scrum as defined in the Scrum Guide?
qs.e: Guía 2020: el SM es responsable de establecer Scrum ayudando a todos a entender la teoría y la práctica.

qs.q: Who is accountable for creating a usable Increment every Sprint?
qs.e: Guía 2020: los Developers crean cualquier aspecto de un Incremento utilizable en cada Sprint.

qs.q: Who creates the Sprint Backlog?
qs.e: Guía 2020: los Developers son responsables de crear el plan del Sprint, el Sprint Backlog.

qs.q: Who is accountable for ordering the Product Backlog?
qs.e: Guía 2020: el PO es responsable de ordenar los elementos del Product Backlog; puede delegar el trabajo, pero sigue siendo responsable.

qs.q: A Scrum Team wants a separate QA sub-team inside the Scrum Team. According to the Scrum Guide:
o: It is required for large products
Scrum recognizes no sub-teams; accountability belongs to the Developers as a whole
It is allowed for teams of more than 10
It is allowed if the Scrum Master approves
qs.e: Guía 2020: no hay subequipos ni jerarquías. Cualquier especialidad sigue siendo Developer.

qs.q: Who holds the accountability for adhering to the Definition of Done?
qs.e: Guía 2020: los Developers están obligados a instilar calidad adhiriéndose a la Definition of Done.

qs.q: Which best describes the Scrum Master?
o: A project manager who reports status
A manager who directs the Developers
A true leader who serves the Scrum Team and the larger organization
qs.e: Guía 2020: el SM es un verdadero líder que sirve al equipo y a la organización. No gestiona ni asigna tareas.

qs.q: The Developers and the Product Owner disagree on the order of the Product Backlog. Who decides?
qs.e: Guía 2020: para que el PO tenga éxito, toda la organización debe respetar sus decisiones, visibles en el orden del Product Backlog.

qs.q: Who is the only person who can cancel a Sprint?
qs.e: Guía 2020: solo el PO tiene la autoridad para cancelar el Sprint.

qs.q: A manager asks the Scrum Master to assign tasks to Developers. What is the best response?
o: Assign tasks according to each person's skills
Ask the Product Owner to assign them
Coach the Developers to decide who does what, since they are self-managing
Let the manager assign them directly
qs.e: Guía 2020: los Developers deciden quién hace qué. El SM coachea en autogestión; asignar tareas es una trampa clásica.

qs.q: Who decides how to turn selected Product Backlog items into an Increment?
qs.e: Guía 2020: los Developers deciden el 'cómo' (Sprint Planning, tema tres).

qs.q: How does the Scrum Master serve the Product Owner?
o: By helping find techniques for effective Product Goal definition and Product Backlog management
By reporting the product's value to executives
By approving the Product Owner's decisions
By deciding the order of the Product Backlog
qs.e: Guía 2020: el SM ayuda al PO a definir el Product Goal, gestionar el Backlog y entender planificación empírica.

qs.q: Which activity is a way the Scrum Master serves the organization?
o: Leading, training and coaching the organization in its Scrum adoption
Approving the release of each Increment
qs.e: Guía 2020: el SM sirve a la organización liderando, entrenando y asesorando la adopción de Scrum.

qs.q: Three Scrum Teams work on the same product. What should they share?
o: A Product Owner per team and one Chief Product Owner
A separate Product Backlog each, merged at the end
The same Product Goal, Product Backlog and Product Owner
qs.e: Guía 2020: varios equipos en el mismo producto comparten Product Goal, Product Backlog y PO.

qs.q: The Product Owner delegates Product Backlog refinement to the Developers. Who remains accountable?
qs.e: Guía 2020: el PO puede delegar el trabajo, pero sigue siendo el responsable.

qs.q: A Developer is blocked by an organizational impediment outside the team's control. What does the Scrum Master do?
o: Helps remove it, working with the organization
Ignores it since it is outside the team
Escalates to the PO who must solve it
Tells the Developer to find a workaround
qs.e: Guía 2020: el SM causa la eliminación de impedimentos al progreso del equipo.

qs.q: A Scrum Team lacks a skill needed to complete a PBI. What does the Scrum Guide imply?
o: Scrum Team should ask for an outside specialist sub-team
The Scrum Team as a whole must have all the skills; Developers decide how to close the gap
The Scrum Master performs the missing task
The Product Owner removes the item permanently
qs.e: Guía 2020: el equipo es multifuncional; debe cubrir las habilidades necesarias, sin subequipos.

qs.q: A stakeholder asks a Developer to add an item to the work for this Sprint. What is the best approach?
o: The Developer adds it to the Sprint Backlog
The Developer refers them to the Product Owner, who is accountable for the Product Backlog
qs.e: Guía 2020: el PO es responsable del Product Backlog; quien quiera cambiar su contenido debe convencer al PO.

qs.q: Which job titles does Scrum recognize within the Developers?
o: Only 'Developer', regardless of the work performed
qs.e: Guía 2020: los Developers son las personas que se comprometen a crear cualquier aspecto del Incremento; Scrum no reconoce títulos.

qs.q: Who ensures that all Scrum events take place and are positive, productive and kept within the timebox?
qs.e: Guía 2020: el SM se asegura de que los eventos tengan lugar y sean positivos, productivos y respeten el timebox.

qs.q: During the Sprint, who can renegotiate the scope with the Developers as more is learned?
qs.e: Guía 2020: el alcance puede clarificarse y renegociarse con el PO a medida que se aprende más.

qs.q: Which of the following is NOT an accountability of the Scrum Master?
o: Causing the removal of impediments to the team's progress
Deciding the order of the Product Backlog
Helping the team focus on creating high-value Increments
qs.e: El orden del Product Backlog es del PO. El SM no decide el contenido ni el orden.

qs.q: Who creates the Product Goal communication, making sure it is explicit?
qs.e: Guía 2020: el PO desarrolla y comunica explícitamente el Product Goal.

qs.q: A Scrum Master also works as a Developer on Sprint Backlog items. Which statement is correct?
o: This is permitted, but the Scrum Master remains accountable for the Scrum Master accountabilities
The Scrum Master must then stop attending events
It makes the Scrum Master the team lead
It is forbidden by the Scrum Guide
qs.e: La Guía 2020 no lo prohíbe: SM, PO o SM que trabajan en elementos del Sprint participan como Developers. La responsabilidad del rol sigue.

qs.q: Which TWO are accountabilities of the Developers? Choose TWO answers.
o: Creating a plan for the Sprint (the Sprint Backlog)
Instilling quality by adhering to the Definition of Done
qs.e: Guía 2020: Developers crean el Sprint Backlog y garantizan calidad con la DoD. Ordenar y cancelar son del PO.

qs.q: Which TWO are accountabilities of the Product Owner? Choose TWO answers.
o: Ensuring Product Backlog items are transparent, visible and understood
Developing and explicitly communicating the Product Goal
qs.e: Guía 2020: el PO gestiona Product Goal y Backlog. Asignar tareas no es de nadie fuera de los Developers.

qs.q: Which TWO describe how the Scrum Master serves the Scrum Team? Choose TWO answers.
o: Coaching team members in self-management and cross-functionality
Helping the team focus on creating high-value Increments that meet the Definition of Done
Reporting on each Developer's performance to management
qs.e: Guía 2020: el SM coachea, ayuda a mantener el foco y retira impedimentos; no asigna ni vigila personas.

qs.q: Which TWO are true about the Scrum Team? Choose TWO answers.
o: It has no sub-teams or hierarchies
It includes a separate testing team
It is a cohesive unit of professionals focused on one objective at a time, the Product Goal
qs.e: Guía 2020: unidad cohesionada sin subequipos ni jerarquías, centrada en el Product Goal.

qs.q: Which TWO describe how the Scrum Master serves the organization? Choose TWO answers.
o: Helping employees and stakeholders understand and enact an empirical approach for complex work
Removing barriers between stakeholders and Scrum Teams
qs.e: Guía 2020: el SM facilita la colaboración de interesados y ayuda a adoptar el enfoque empírico.

qs.q: The Scrum Master is the manager of the Developers.
qs.e: El SM es un líder-servidor, no un gestor; no dirige ni asigna al equipo.

qs.q: The Product Owner may delegate work to others but remains accountable.
qs.e: Guía 2020: el PO puede delegar, pero sigue siendo responsable.

qs.q: A Scrum Team may include a dedicated QA sub-team.
qs.e: No hay subequipos en Scrum; la Guía 2020 lo dice explícitamente.

qs.q: The Developers can cancel a Sprint when the Sprint Goal becomes obsolete.
qs.e: Solo el PO puede cancelar el Sprint.

qs.q: What is the maximum length of a Sprint?
qs.e: Guía 2020: los Sprints son de un mes o menos, con duración constante.

qs.q: What is the maximum timebox for Sprint Planning for a one-month Sprint?
qs.e: Guía 2020: Sprint Planning máximo 8 horas para un Sprint de un mes; menos si es más corto.

qs.q: What is the timebox of the Daily Scrum?
qs.e: Guía 2020: el Daily Scrum dura 15 minutos, todos los días de trabajo del Sprint.

qs.q: What is the maximum timebox of the Sprint Review for a one-month Sprint?
qs.e: Guía 2020: Sprint Review máximo 4 horas para un Sprint de un mes.

qs.q: What is the maximum timebox of the Sprint Retrospective for a one-month Sprint?
qs.e: Guía 2020: la Retrospectiva dura como máximo 3 horas para un Sprint de un mes.

qs.q: Which topics are addressed in Sprint Planning?
o: Budget, schedule and the project's scope baseline
Who did what last Sprint, which bugs were found, and who is to blame
Why is the Sprint valuable, what can be Done this Sprint, and how will the chosen work get done
Release dates, team vacations and hiring
qs.e: Guía 2020: tres temas: el por qué (Sprint Goal), el qué y el cómo.

qs.q: Who must attend the Daily Scrum?
o: The whole Scrum Team plus stakeholders
The Scrum Master and Product Owner
qs.e: Guía 2020: el Daily Scrum es para los Developers. Si PO o SM trabajan en elementos del Sprint, participan como Developers.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the Daily Scrum?
o: Inspect progress toward the Sprint Goal and adapt the Sprint Backlog as necessary
Report status to the Scrum Master
qs.e: Guía 2020: inspeccionar el avance hacia el Sprint Goal y adaptar el Sprint Backlog.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the Sprint Review?
o: Formally accept the Increment from stakeholders
Inspect the outcome of the Sprint and determine future adaptations
qs.e: Guía 2020: inspeccionar el resultado del Sprint y determinar adaptaciones futuras.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the Sprint Retrospective?
o: Plan ways to increase quality and effectiveness
qs.e: Guía 2020: la retrospectiva planifica formas de aumentar calidad y efectividad.

qs.q: Under what condition may a Sprint be cancelled?
o: When the Scrum Master finds a risk
When the Developers are behind schedule
When the Sprint Goal becomes obsolete
qs.e: Guía 2020: el PO puede cancelar si el Sprint Goal queda obsoleto, p. ej. por cambio de rumbo.

qs.q: During the Sprint, which of the following is true about scope?
o: Scope may be clarified and renegotiated with the Product Owner as more is learned
Scope is frozen once Sprint Planning ends
Scope is set by the Developers alone
Scope changes need Scrum Master approval
qs.e: Guía 2020: no se hacen cambios que pongan en peligro el Sprint Goal; el alcance se renegocia con el PO.

qs.q: During the Sprint, which of the following must NOT happen?
o: Changes are made that endanger the Sprint Goal
The scope is clarified with the Product Owner
qs.e: Guía 2020: durante el Sprint no se hacen cambios que pongan en peligro el Sprint Goal ni se reduce la calidad.

qs.q: When does a new Sprint start?
o: After a break decided by the Scrum Master
Immediately after the conclusion of the previous Sprint
After the Product Owner approves the Increment
qs.e: Guía 2020: un nuevo Sprint comienza inmediatamente después de concluir el anterior.

qs.q: When does the Sprint Retrospective occur?
o: In the middle of the Sprint
After the Sprint Review and prior to the next Sprint Planning
qs.e: Guía 2020: la retrospectiva concluye el Sprint; ocurre tras la Review y antes de la siguiente Planning.

qs.q: A team wants to run a 'Sprint 0' to set up infrastructure before the first Sprint. How does the Scrum Guide treat this?
o: Scrum does not define a Sprint 0; every Sprint aims to produce a usable Increment
It is a Sprint with no Sprint Goal
It must be approved by the Product Owner
It is required for all new products
qs.e: La Guía no define el 'Sprint 0'. Truco clásico: todo Sprint se orienta a crear un Incremento útil.

qs.q: A team proposes a 'hardening Sprint' to fix defects before release. According to Scrum:
o: It is allowed when velocity decreases
Each Sprint must produce a Done Increment; hardening Sprints are not part of Scrum
It is required before every release
qs.e: Guía 2020: cada Incremento debe ser utilizable al final del Sprint cumpliendo la DoD. No hay 'sprint de estabilización'.

qs.q: Why would a team choose shorter Sprints?
o: To avoid delivering a Done Increment
To reduce the number of Scrum events
To limit risk and generate more learning cycles
To avoid refining the Product Backlog
qs.e: Guía 2020: los Sprints más cortos generan más ciclos de aprendizaje y limitan el costo y esfuerzo a un periodo pequeño.

qs.q: Who selects the structure and techniques for the Daily Scrum?
qs.e: Guía 2020: los Developers pueden elegir la estructura y técnicas, siempre que se centren en el progreso hacia el Sprint Goal.

qs.q: What does the Scrum Master do with respect to the Daily Scrum?
o: Ensures that the Developers have the meeting, but the Developers are responsible for conducting it
Takes notes and reports to management
Runs the meeting and asks each Developer three questions
qs.e: Guía 2020: el SM se asegura de que se celebre, pero los Developers lo conducen.

qs.q: How should the Sprint Review be described?
o: A presentation by the Product Owner
A working session where the Scrum Team and stakeholders collaborate; it is not limited to a presentation
A demo where stakeholders formally accept the work
qs.e: Guía 2020: la Review no debe limitarse a una presentación; es una sesión de trabajo.

qs.q: What may happen at the Sprint Review regarding the Product Backlog?
o: It is replaced by the Sprint Backlog
It may be adjusted to meet new opportunities
It can only be changed by management
qs.e: Guía 2020: el Product Backlog puede ajustarse para aprovechar nuevas oportunidades.

qs.q: Who crafts the Sprint Goal?
o: The entire Scrum Team collaboratively during Sprint Planning
qs.e: Guía 2020: el Scrum Team colabora en el Sprint Goal durante la Planning.

qs.q: What does the Sprint Retrospective inspect?
o: How the last Sprint went regarding individuals, interactions, processes, tools and the Definition of Done
qs.e: Guía 2020: se inspecciona individuos, interacciones, procesos, herramientas y DoD.

qs.q: The Developers finish all the work forecast for the Sprint two days early. What happens?
o: The Scrum Master cancels the Sprint
The Sprint continues until its timebox ends; the team and the Product Owner can add work to the Sprint Backlog
qs.e: Guía 2020: un Sprint es un timebox fijo y no termina antes. Se puede renegociar más trabajo con el PO.

qs.q: Who decides whether a Sprint should be cancelled when the Sprint Goal becomes obsolete?
qs.e: Guía 2020: solo el PO puede cancelar el Sprint, y la causa típica es que el Sprint Goal quede obsoleto.

qs.q: The Developers realize they cannot complete all forecast work. What should they do?
o: Ask the Scrum Master to remove items
Collaborate with the Product Owner to renegotiate the Sprint Backlog while keeping the Sprint Goal
qs.e: Guía 2020: el alcance puede renegociarse con el PO. No se extiende el Sprint ni se baja la calidad.

qs.q: What guides the Sprint Planning's selection of work the Developers can do?
o: The Developers' forecast of what they can complete, plus the Sprint Goal
Past velocity as a fixed commitment
qs.e: Guía 2020: los Developers seleccionan elementos y pronostican; el Sprint Goal da el foco.

qs.q: Which events are held inside the Sprint?
o: All Scrum events, including Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Review and Sprint Retrospective
Only Sprint Planning and the Daily Scrum
qs.e: Guía 2020: el Sprint contiene todos los eventos; es el contenedor del resto.

qs.q: Which TWO topics belong to Sprint Planning? Choose TWO answers.
o: How many hours has each Developer logged?
Who is to blame for last Sprint's defects?
What can be Done this Sprint?
qs.e: Guía 2020: por qué, qué y cómo. No se evalúa individuos.

qs.q: Which TWO statements about the Daily Scrum are correct? Choose TWO answers.
o: It is a 15-minute event for the Developers
It is a status report to the Scrum Master
It is held at the same time and place every working day to reduce complexity
The Product Owner must ask each Developer to answer three questions
qs.e: Guía 2020: 15 minutos, mismos hora y lugar. No exige formato de tres preguntas.

qs.q: Which TWO are outcomes of the Sprint Review? Choose TWO answers.
o: Discussion of what to do next with stakeholders
A formal sign-off required to release
An evaluation of each Developer's performance
qs.e: Guía 2020: la Review genera un Product Backlog revisado y decisiones sobre qué hacer. No es aprobación formal.

qs.q: Which TWO things does the Sprint Retrospective address? Choose TWO answers.
qs.e: Guía 2020: se inspecciona individuos, interacciones, procesos, herramientas y DoD.

qs.q: Which TWO statements about the Sprint are true? Choose TWO answers.
o: A new Sprint starts immediately after the previous one ends
It is one month or less in length
It can be extended if the work isn't Done
It must be preceded by a Sprint 0
qs.e: Guía 2020: duración fija de un mes o menos; sin pausas ni extensiones; no hay Sprint 0.

qs.q: Which TWO statements about cancelling a Sprint are true? Choose TWO answers.
o: The Developers can cancel it if they are behind
It can happen if the Sprint Goal becomes obsolete
The Scrum Master can cancel it for lack of progress
Only the Product Owner can cancel it
qs.e: Guía 2020: solo el PO cancela, y solo si el Sprint Goal queda obsoleto.

qs.q: The Sprint Review is a status meeting at which stakeholders formally approve the Increment.
qs.e: La Review es una sesión de trabajo colaborativa para inspeccionar el resultado; no es una aprobación.

qs.q: The Daily Scrum must follow the 'three questions' format.
qs.e: La Guía 2020 deja la estructura a los Developers. Las tres preguntas fueron una sugerencia antigua.

qs.q: Sprint Planning for a shorter Sprint is usually shorter than 8 hours.
qs.e: Guía 2020: el timebox de 8 horas es para un Sprint de un mes; suele ser más corto en Sprints más cortos.

qs.q: A Sprint can be extended if the Developers need more time to finish.
qs.e: Un Sprint es un timebox fijo; no se extiende. El alcance se renegocia.

qs.q: The Sprint Retrospective takes place after the Sprint Review and before the next Sprint Planning.
qs.e: Guía 2020: la retrospectiva concluye el Sprint, tras la Review y antes de la siguiente Planning.

qs.q: Which are the three Scrum artifacts?
o: Product Goal, Sprint Goal and Definition of Done
Release plan, Sprint Backlog and Increment
Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog and Increment
Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog and burn-down chart
qs.e: Guía 2020: los artefactos son Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog e Incremento.

qs.q: Which commitment belongs to the Product Backlog?
qs.e: Guía 2020: Product Goal para Product Backlog, Sprint Goal para Sprint Backlog, DoD para Increment.

qs.q: Which commitment belongs to the Sprint Backlog?
qs.e: Guía 2020: el compromiso del Sprint Backlog es el Sprint Goal.

qs.q: Which commitment belongs to the Increment?
qs.e: Guía 2020: el compromiso del Incremento es la Definition of Done.

qs.q: How is the Product Backlog best described?
o: A fixed list of requirements agreed at the start
A collection of tasks assigned to Developers
An emergent, ordered list of what is needed to improve the product, and the single source of work for the Scrum Team
qs.e: Guía 2020: lista emergente y ordenada; única fuente de trabajo del equipo.

qs.q: What is the Product Goal?
o: The Definition of Done for the product
A list of features for the next release
A long-term objective for the Scrum Team; the Scrum Team must fulfill or abandon one objective before taking on the next
qs.e: Guía 2020: el Product Goal describe un estado futuro del producto; solo uno a la vez.

qs.q: What does the Sprint Backlog consist of?
o: The Sprint Goal (why), the Product Backlog items selected (what) and an actionable plan for delivering the Increment (how)
Only the tasks the Scrum Master assigned
qs.e: Guía 2020: Sprint Goal, elementos seleccionados y plan de entrega.

qs.q: Who can update the Sprint Backlog during the Sprint?
qs.e: Guía 2020: el Sprint Backlog se actualiza a lo largo del Sprint; los Developers lo gestionan.

qs.q: What is an Increment?
o: A work item still in progress
A concrete stepping stone toward the Product Goal that is usable
A release candidate approved by management
qs.e: Guía 2020: un Incremento es un peldaño concreto hacia el Product Goal y debe ser utilizable.

qs.q: When can work be considered part of an Increment?
o: When tests pass but documentation is pending
When the Product Owner approves it informally
When the Developers say it is done
When it meets the Definition of Done
qs.e: Guía 2020: el trabajo no puede considerarse parte de un Incremento a menos que cumpla la DoD.

qs.q: A Product Backlog item does not meet the Definition of Done at the end of the Sprint. What happens?
o: It cannot be released or presented in the Sprint Review and returns to the Product Backlog
It is released with a known-issue list
It automatically goes into the next Sprint
qs.e: Guía 2020: un elemento que no cumple la DoD no puede liberarse ni presentarse; vuelve al Backlog.

qs.q: If the Definition of Done is part of the organization's standards, what must Scrum Teams do?
o: Ask the Product Owner for exceptions
Replace it with a lighter one
Ignore it if the team has its own
qs.e: Guía 2020: si es un estándar de la organización, todos los equipos lo siguen como mínimo.

qs.q: Several Scrum Teams work on the same product. What must they do regarding the Definition of Done?
o: Mutually define and comply with the same Definition of Done
Let each Product Owner define it
qs.e: Guía 2020: los equipos que trabajan en el mismo producto deben definir y cumplir mutuamente la DoD.

qs.q: What is Product Backlog refinement?
o: A job done only by the Product Owner
A phase held before the first Sprint
A formal Scrum event held every Sprint
The ongoing act of breaking down and further defining Product Backlog items into smaller, more precise items
qs.e: Guía 2020: refinamiento es una actividad continua, no un evento. Truco: no es un evento formal.

qs.q: Who is responsible for sizing the Product Backlog items?
o: The Developers, who will do the work
qs.e: Guía 2020: los Developers dimensionan; el PO puede influir ayudándoles a entender y seleccionar.

qs.q: When can an Increment be delivered to stakeholders?
o: Before the end of the Sprint; the Sprint Review is not a gate to releasing value
qs.e: Guía 2020: un Incremento puede entregarse antes del final del Sprint; la Review no es una puerta de liberación.

qs.q: Which statement about burn-down charts is correct?
o: They must be shown in the Sprint Review
They are useful practices for forecasting, but they do not replace the importance of empiricism
qs.e: Guía 2020: menciona burn-down/up y flujo acumulado como útiles pero no obligatorios.

qs.q: When is the Sprint Goal created?
o: Before the Sprint by the Product Owner
During Sprint Planning, and then added to the Sprint Backlog
qs.e: Guía 2020: el Sprint Goal se crea en la Planning y se añade al Sprint Backlog.

qs.q: What does the Definition of Done create?
o: A shared understanding of what work was completed as part of the Increment
A way to track individual productivity
A list of tasks for the next Sprint
qs.e: Guía 2020: la DoD crea transparencia.

qs.q: Which Product Backlog items are considered ready for selection in Sprint Planning?
o: Those that can be Done by the Scrum Team within one Sprint
qs.e: Guía 2020: los elementos que pueden Hacerse en un Sprint se consideran listos para selección.

qs.q: Who is accountable for Product Backlog content, availability and ordering?
qs.e: Guía 2020: el PO es responsable del contenido, disponibilidad y orden del Product Backlog.

qs.q: A team wants a Definition of Done weaker than the organization's standard. Is this permitted?
o: Yes, if the Sprint Goal is at risk
Yes, if the Scrum Master agrees
No; the organizational standard is the minimum, the team may add stricter criteria
qs.e: Guía 2020: el estándar de la organización es el mínimo; el equipo puede añadir criterios más estrictos.

qs.q: At the end of the Sprint, one item is 90 percent complete according to the Developers. What is its status?
o: Not Done: it is not part of the Increment and returns to the Product Backlog
qs.e: Guía 2020: lo no Hecho no forma parte del Incremento. No existe el 'casi hecho'.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the Sprint Goal?
o: To list every item in the Sprint
To provide coherence and focus, encouraging the Scrum Team to work together rather than on separate initiatives
To set the maximum number of items
qs.e: Guía 2020: el Sprint Goal es un objetivo único que da coherencia y foco.

qs.q: What does the Sprint Backlog represent?
o: The final plan for the whole product
A contract between the PO and Developers
A highly visible, real-time picture of the work the Developers plan to accomplish during the Sprint
A list of tasks assigned by the Scrum Master
qs.e: Guía 2020: es una imagen en tiempo real, muy visible, del trabajo planificado.

qs.q: A Product Owner wants a complete, fixed Product Backlog before the first Sprint. How does the Scrum Guide describe the Product Backlog?
o: It is frozen during each Sprint
It must be completed before the first Sprint
It is only changed at the end of a release
It is never complete and constantly changes; the earliest development lays out initially known requirements
qs.e: Guía 2020: el Product Backlog es emergente y nunca está completo.

qs.q: Where does the Product Goal live?
o: In the Product Backlog; the rest of the Backlog emerges to define what fulfils the Product Goal
qs.e: Guía 2020: el Product Goal está en el Product Backlog.

qs.q: Which TWO statements about the Product Backlog are correct? Choose TWO answers.
o: It is fixed at the start of the project
It is ordered by the Product Owner
It is frozen during the Sprint by the Scrum Master
qs.e: Guía 2020: emergente, nunca completo; el PO es responsable de su orden.

qs.q: Which TWO are Scrum commitments? Choose TWO answers.
qs.e: Guía 2020: PG, SG y DoD son los compromisos. Velocidad y burn-down no lo son.

qs.q: Which TWO belong in the Sprint Backlog? Choose TWO answers.
o: An actionable plan for delivering the Increment
Task assignments set by the Scrum Master
qs.e: Guía 2020: Sprint Goal, elementos seleccionados y plan. Nada de asignaciones del SM.

qs.q: Which TWO statements about the Increment are correct? Choose TWO answers.
o: It is only the work completed by the last Developer
It may include work that is nearly done
It is the sum of all completed Product Backlog items plus the Increments of all previous Sprints
qs.e: Guía 2020: el Incremento es acumulativo y debe ser utilizable.

qs.q: Which TWO statements about the Definition of Done are correct? Choose TWO answers.
o: It is defined solely by the Scrum Master and cannot change
It creates transparency by giving everyone a shared understanding
It applies only to testing activities
It is a formal description of the state of the Increment when it meets the quality measures required
qs.e: Guía 2020: describe el estado del Incremento; crea transparencia; el equipo la mejora.

qs.q: Burn-down charts are mandatory in Scrum.
qs.e: La Guía 2020 no los exige; son prácticas útiles que no sustituyen al empirismo.

qs.q: A Product Backlog item that doesn't meet the Definition of Done may be shown in the Sprint Review if clearly marked.
qs.e: Guía 2020: no puede liberarse ni presentarse en la Review; vuelve al Product Backlog.

qs.q: The Scrum Team works toward one Product Goal at a time.
qs.e: Guía 2020: el equipo debe cumplir o abandonar un objetivo antes de asumir el siguiente.
